description.zh-CN: 抓取 HTTP(S) 页面正文（限长、限超时）
description.en-US: Fetch an HTTP(S) page body (size-capped, timeout-capped)

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: HTTP GET a URL and return status + body (transport errors fail; 4xx/5xx come back as data). Args: url (http/https), max_bytes (default 262144, max 1048576), timeout_secs (default 20, max 60).
